We visited The Souled Store at Vesu VIP Road, Surat after getting very good recommendations about the brand and its online collection. We were two families shopping together and it was our first visit to the store.

We genuinely liked the collection and started trying different outfits and sizes, which is completely normal for first-time customers who are not aware of the brand’s fitting and sizing.

However, the behavior of most of the staff was extremely rude, disrespectful and unacceptable. One of the staff members even misbehaved and used abusive language towards a lady from our family, which was extremely shocking and disturbing. Such behavior towards customers, especially women, is completely unacceptable in any professional retail store.

Instead of helping customers properly, the staff created an uncomfortable and hostile environment. What made the situation worse was that the store manager was not present at the time, and there was nobody responsible enough to handle the matter professionally or resolve the issue.

Only one or two staff members were soft spoken and behaved politely — the rest of the team was rude and arrogant throughout the visit.

A brand cannot grow only because of good products and trendy collections. Respectful customer service is equally important. We entered the store excited to shop, but left feeling insulted, disappointed and deeply upset by the way we were treated.

Strongly request the management of The Souled Store to take this matter seriously and ensure proper staff training and discipline at the Surat Vesu VIP Road outlet so that no other customer has to face such disrespectful behavior again.
